capabilities: Drag list items to reorder them via a hover handle
Collapse and expand nested list items by right-clicking the handle
Drag items between separate lists at the same indent level
Drag list items between files across editor panes
Renumber ordered lists automatically on drop
extras: Source mode is not supported; cross-file drag works only in live preview.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to rearrange list items by dragging; reordering means cutting and pasting lines manually.
summary: Drag-and-drop reordering of Markdown list items (bullets, tasks, ordered lists) in reading view and live preview, with collapse and cross-list moves.
